title: The day Steve Jobs dissed me in a keynote (2010)
summary: A personal anecdote from Derek Sivers recounting the experience of being publicly criticized by Steve Jobs during an Apple keynote presentation in 2010.
problem_solved: This is not a technical solution; it's a personal storytelling piece about handling public criticism from a powerful figure.
